```{r include=FALSE}
# Disable scientific notation
options(scipen=999)

#data -> data.h
#create guassina transformation
#data.h$gaussian.risk <- Gaussianize(data.h$Risk_odds)
#data.h$gaussian.gain <- Gaussianize(data.h$Gain_odds)

Neuroethics_Judgement %>% 
 dplyr::select(user_id, condition, Risk_Beta, Gain_Beta, Risk_sig, Gain_sig, marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain, Yes, No) %>% 
  mutate(inverse.risk = -marginal.effect.risk)%>% 
  mutate(lambda = -Risk_Beta/Gain_Beta) %>%
  mutate(Risk_odds = exp(Risk_Beta)) %>%
  mutate(Gain_odds = exp(Gain_Beta)) %>%
  mutate(loss_aversion = as.factor(ifelse(lambda > 1, "loss_aversion", "Not_loss_aversion"))) %>% 
  mutate(risk_aversion = as.factor(ifelse(Risk_odds > 1, "risk_seeking", "risk_aversion"))) %>% 
  mutate(CogMood = as.factor(ifelse(condition == "Mood", "Mood", "Cognitive"))) %>% 
  distinct() -> data.h
```



##**Risk, benefit, and risk*benefit marginal effects for each cog domain (Descriptive)**

```{r echo=FALSE}
data.h %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, condition, marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain) %>% 
  mutate(marginal.effect.risk = marginal.effect.risk) %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id = c("user_id", "condition") , variable.name = "type", value.name = "marginal.effect") -> test

plotdata <- test %>%
  group_by(type, condition) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean = mean(marginal.effect),
            sd = sd(marginal.effect),
            se = sd/sqrt(n),
            ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) %>% na.omit()

pd <- position_dodge(0.2)
ggplot(plotdata, aes(x =type, 
                     y= mean,
                     ymin = mean - 2*se,
                     ymax= mean + 2*se, 
                     group=condition,
                     color=condition)) +
  scale_x_discrete('Type')+
  scale_y_continuous('Marginal Effect',limits=c(-0.005,.01)) +
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = type, y = mean),size=1,width=.2, position = pd) + 
  geom_point(position=pd, size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) + 
  labs(x = "Type", 
       y = "Average Marginal Effect", 
       title  = "AVE for Model by Cognive Domain")
```

##**Statistical test for Risk vs. Benefit (gains are stronger than risks; interpretation- driven by reference point)**

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data.h %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, condition, marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain, Yes, No) %>% 
  mutate(marginal.effect.risk = -marginal.effect.risk) %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id = c("user_id", "condition", "Yes", "No") , variable.name = "type", value.name = "marginal.effect") -> test
test$condition <- relevel(test$condition, "Mood")

lm.1 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type, test) 

lm.2 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type + No, test) 

lm.3 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No, test)

anova(lm.1, lm.2, lm.3, test="LRT")

library(multcomp)
summary(glht(lm.3, mcp(type="Tukey")))
summary(lm.1)
# model
#mod <- stats::lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No, test)

# plot
#ggstatsplot::ggcoefstats(mod, k = 4L)
```

**Table 1:** Main effects and interaction linear models for Average Marginal effects controling for responsce count.
```{r printLM table,echo=FALSE}
tab_model(lm.1, lm.2, lm.3, 
          digits = 4, 
          show.df = T, 
          show.stat = T, 
          string.pred = "Ind. Variable", 
          col.order = c("est","ci","df","stat","p"), 
          dv.labels = c("Type", "Type + No", "Type*No")
          )
```
*Note:* The Statistic represent the t-statistic used to obtain the p-value. CI = the 95% confidence interval of the Estimate. 


##**Interdomain interactions (No difference across domains)**
```{r, echo=FALSE}
lm.1 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No, test)

lm.2 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No + condition, test)

lm.3 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No + condition:type, test)

lm.4 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ (type+No+condition)^2, test)

lm.5 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No*condition, test)




anova(lm.1, lm.2, lm.3, lm.4, lm.5, test="LRT")
```

```{r, echo}
tab_model(lm.1, lm.2, lm.3, lm.4, lm.5,
          digits = 4, 
          show.df = T, 
          show.stat = T, 
          string.pred = "Ind. Variable", 
          col.order = c("est","ci","df","stat","p"), 
          dv.labels = c("base", "condition", "condition*type", "all 2way interactions", "3 way interaction")
          )
```
*Note:* The Statistic represent the t-statistic used to obtain the p-value. CI = the 95% confidence interval of the Estimate.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

Neuroethics_Judgement %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, condition, risk, gain, ratio, experimental_treatment_selected, Yes, No) %>% 
  group_by(user_id) %>% #group by user id
  mutate(risk.c = scale(risk, scale = F)) %>% #mean center variables
  mutate(gain.c = scale(gain, scale = F))  %>% 
  mutate(treatment = ifelse(experimental_treatment_selected == "Yes to treatment", 1, 0)) -> data
  data$condition <- relevel(data$condition, "Mood")

mlm <- glmer(treatment ~ risk.c + gain.c + (risk.c + gain.c | user_id),  
                    data = data, family = binomial, 
                    control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
                    nAGQ = 0) 
  
mlm.1 <- glmer(treatment ~ risk.c*gain.c + (risk.c + gain.c | user_id),  
                    data = data, family = binomial, 
                    control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
                    nAGQ = 0) 

mlm.2 <- glmer(treatment ~ risk.c*gain.c + No + (risk.c + gain.c | user_id),  
                    data = data, family = binomial, 
                    control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
                    nAGQ = 0) 

mlm.3 <- glmer(treatment ~ risk.c*gain.c*No + (risk.c + gain.c | user_id),  
                    data = data, family = binomial, 
                    control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
                    nAGQ = 0) 

mlm.4 <- glmer(treatment ~ risk.c*gain.c*No + condition + (risk.c + gain.c | user_id),  
                    data = data, family = binomial, 
                    control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
                    nAGQ = 0) 

anova(mlm, mlm.1, mlm.2, mlm.3, mlm.4)

summary(mlm.1)

# for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# model
mod <- stats::lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No, test)

# plot
ggstatsplot::ggcoefstats(mlm.3)

data.h %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, CogMood, marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain, Yes, No) %>% 
  mutate(marginal.effect.risk = -marginal.effect.risk) %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id = c("user_id", "CogMood", "Yes", "No") , variable.name = "type", value.name = "marginal.effect") -> test
test$CogMood <- relevel(test$CogMood, "Mood")

lm.1 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No, test)

lm.2 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No + CogMood, test)

lm.3 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No + CogMood:type, test)

lm.4 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ (type+No+CogMood)^2, test)

lm.5 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No*CogMood, test)

(anova(lm.1, lm.2, lm.3, lm.4, lm.5, test="LRT"))

```

```{r h1 using the transfomed dv, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#one way t-test for risk to that of zero
t1 <- t.test(data.h$gaussian.risk, mu=0, var.equal=TRUE)
#one way t-test for gain to that of zero
t2 <- t.test(data.h$gaussian.gain, mu=0, var.equal=TRUE)

t3 <- t.test(data.h$gaussian.risk, data.h$gaussian.gain, paired=TRUE, var.equal = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")

#create table
tab <- map_df(list(t1, t2, t3), tidy)  
kable(tab[c("method","estimate", "statistic", "conf.low", "conf.high", "p.value")], caption = "Transformed data t test")
```

```{r h1 using raw dv, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
t1 <- t.test(data.h$marginal.effect.risk, mu=0, var.equal=TRUE)
#one way t-test for gain to that of zero
t2 <- t.test(data.h$marginal.effect.gain, mu=0, var.equal=TRUE)


#two way t-test for risk and gain
t3 <- t.test(data.h$inverse.risk, data.h$marginal.effect.gain, paired=TRUE, var.equal = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")

#create table
tab <- map_df(list(t1, t2, t3), tidy)
kable(tab[c("method","estimate", "statistic", "conf.low", "conf.high", "p.value")], caption = "Raw data t test")

#effect sizes
mean(data.h$Risk_Beta, na.rm=T) / sd(data.h$Risk_Beta, na.rm=T)
mean(data.h$Gain_Beta, na.rm=T) / sd(data.h$Gain_Beta, na.rm=T)

(mean(data.h$Risk_odds, na.rm=T) - mean(data.h$Gain_odds, na.rm=T)) / (sd(data.h$Risk_odds, na.rm=T) - sd(data.h$Gain_odds, na.rm=T))
```

```{r h1 nonparametric, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#independent 2-group Mann-Whitney U Test
#testing that the H0 that the mediain of risk is equal to zero
t1 <- wilcox.test(data.h$Risk_Beta, mu =0, conf.int = T, conf.level = 0.95) 
#testing that the H0 that the mediain of gain is equal to zero

t2 <- wilcox.test(data.h$Gain_Beta, mu =0,  conf.int = T, conf.level = 0.95) 

#take absolute weights to make the value risk and gain comparison
#dependent 2-group Wilcoxon Signed Rank Test
#testing that the h0 that mediain values of risk and gain are equal

t3 <- wilcox.test(data.h$abs.risk, data.h$abs.gain, alt = "two.sided", paired = TRUE,  conf.int = T, conf.level = 0.95)
#t3 <- wilcox.test(data.h$Risk_odds, data.h$Gain_odds, alt = "two.sided", paired = TRUE,  conf.int = T, conf.level = 0.95)

#create table
tab <- map_df(list(t1, t2, t3), tidy)
kable(tab[c("method","estimate", "statistic", "conf.low", "conf.high", "p.value")], caption = "Nonparametric tests")
```

```{r parametric h2, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
aovrisk <- aov(gaussian.risk ~ condition, data=data.h)
aovgain <- aov(gaussian.gain ~ condition, data=data.h)

summary(aovrisk)
summary(aovgain)

# Tukey test to study each of the conditions:
TUKEYrisk <- TukeyHSD(aovrisk)
TUKEYgain <- TukeyHSD(aovgain)
#test representation :
par(mar=c(5,20,4,1)+.1)
plot(TUKEYrisk , las=1 , col="orange")
kable(TUKEYrisk$condition)
```

```{r data munge, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
data <- read.csv("../data/Cleaned_Pilot/Cleaned_Pilot.08.csv", header=TRUE, comment.char="#", stringsAsFactors=TRUE)%>%
    dplyr::select(user_id, condition, risk, gain, experimental_treatment_selected)
#standarize the variables
data <- group_by(data, user_id) %>% 
   mutate(risk_c= scale(risk, scale = F)) %>% 
   mutate(gain_c= scale(gain, scale = F))
#this runs a logisic model for the data grouped by user id using the scaled IV as created above
m.lr = by(data, data$user_id, function(x) glm(experimental_treatment_selected ~ risk_c + gain_c, data = x, family = binomial(link = "logit"),control=glm.control(maxit=50)))
#extract the betas
beta= list()
n <- nrow(data)/75
user_id <- names(m.lr)
for (i in 1:n){
dat = m.lr[[i]]$coefficients
  beta[[i]] = dat
}
x = do.call(rbind, beta)
colnames(x) <-  c('Intercept', 'risk_beta', 'gain_beta')
x <-  cbind.data.frame(x, user_id)

data.h <- merge(data, x, "user_id") %>% 
  distinct(user_id, condition,  risk_beta, gain_beta)

#save(data.h, file = "data.RData")
```

```{r boxcox transformation, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(MASS)

Box = boxcox(data.h$Risk_Beta + 1 ~ 1,    # Transform amount as a single vector, add a constant
             lambda = seq(-6,6,0.1)      # Try values -6 to 6 by 0.1
             )
Cox = data.frame(Box$x, Box$y)            # Create a data frame with the results
Cox2 = Cox[with(Cox, order(-Cox$Box.y)),] # Order the new data frame by decreasing y
Cox2[1,]                                  # Display the lambda with the greatest
                                          #    log likelihood
lambda = Cox2[1, "Box.x"]                 # Extract that lambda
T_box = tibble(box_risk = ((data.h$Risk_Beta + 1) ^ lambda - 1)/lambda)   # Transform the original data
ggplot(T_box, aes(box_risk)) + geom_density()
shapiro.test(T_box$box_risk) #check for normality
```

```{r condition comparaisions, eval=FALSE, fig.height=11, fig.width=20, dpi=300, include=FALSE}
#### The function STARTS here ####
plotTukeyHSD <- plotTukeysHSD <- function(tukey.out,
                           x.axis.label = "Comparison",
                           y.axis.label = "Effect Size",
                       axis.adjust = 0,
                       adjust.x.spacing = 10){
  
  tukey.out <- as.data.frame(tukey.out[[1]])
  means <- tukey.out$diff
  categories <- row.names(tukey.out)
  groups <- length(categories)
  ci.low <- tukey.out$lwr
  ci.up  <- tukey.out$upr                         
  
  n.means <- length(means)
   
  #determine where to plot points along x-axis
  x.values <- 1:n.means
  x.values <- x.values/adjust.x.spacing
  
                             
  # calculate values for plotting limits            
  y.max <- max(ci.up) +                    
    max(ci.up)*axis.adjust
  y.min <- min(ci.low) - 
    max(ci.low)*axis.adjust
  
  if(groups == 2){ x.values <- c(0.25, 0.5)}
  if(groups == 3){ x.values <- c(0.25, 0.5,0.75)}
  
  x.axis.min <- min(x.values)-0.05
  x.axis.max <- max(x.values)+0.05
  
  x.limits <- c(x.axis.min,x.axis.max)
  
  #Plot means
  plot(means ~ x.values,
       xlim = x.limits,
       ylim = c(y.min,y.max),
       xaxt = "n",
       xlab = "",
       ylab = "",
       cex = 1.25,
       pch = 16, 
       col="red")
  
  axis(side = 1, 
       at = x.values,
       labels = categories,  
       las = 3, cex.axis= 0.8,
       font=2)
  
  #Plot upper error bar 
  lwd. <- 2
  arrows(y0 = means,
         x0 = x.values,
         y1 = ci.up,
         x1 = x.values,
         length = 0,
         lwd = lwd.)
  
  #Plot lower error bar
  arrows(y0 = means,
         x0 = x.values,
         y1 = ci.low,
         x1 = x.values,
         length = 0,
         lwd = lwd.) 
  
  #add reference line at 0
  abline(h = 0, col = 2, lwd = 2, lty =2)
  
  #mtext(text = x.axis.label,side = 1,line = 1.75)
  mtext(text = y.axis.label,side = 2,line = 1.95)
  mtext(text = "Error bars = 95% CI",side = 3,line = 0,adj = 0)
  
  
}
par(mar=c(20,4,4,1)+.1)
plotTukeyHSD(TUKEYrisk)
par(mar=c(20,4,4,1)+.1)
plotTukeyHSD(TUKEYgain)
#### The function ENDS here ####
```
